about_the_game:
Nightork Adventures 3 brings back the fast-paced, explosive action of the Nightork series — now with deeper strategy and more destruction than ever!

Each enemy is protected by three shields, and every shield has one of two colors: Magic or Antimagic. To destroy them, you must hit the correct colors in the right order — precision and timing are everything.

Collect powerups to trigger massive explosions and chain reactions, and choose one of three Totems to shape your playstyle:

🐻 Ice Bear – Boosts defense and absorbs incoming damage.
🐅 Snow Tiger – Increases attack power and fire rate.
🦅 Frost Raven – Enhances mobility and special energy regeneration.

Face waves of enemies across three unique arenas, each filled with intense battles, glowing projectiles, and spectacular effects.

Features:

  • Dynamic Magic/Antimagic shield system

  • Three Totems with unique bonuses

  • Explosive powerups and chain reactions

  • Three arenas packed with fast-paced action

  • Arcade-style gameplay with a strategic twist

Can you master the rhythm of destruction and survive the chaos?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 1500X / Intel Core i5 7600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Radeon RX570 / Nvidia Gtx 970
  • DirectX: Version 9.0c
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: On-board Sound
  • Additional Notes: Full HD Monitor
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 2600X / Intel Core i5 8600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Radeon RX Vega 56 / Nvidia Gtx 1070
  • DirectX: Version 9.0c
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: On-board Sound
  • Additional Notes: Full HD Monitor
